Landing of record: walker/ultimate-lens-walker @ 3cbb08c375 (parent 341769226b), all six blobs read back byte-identical; landed-tree selftests: test_packet_identity 24/24, test_w0_pack 0 failures, test_wiring_capture 74/74. What the build changes: lensrecord gains packet_id_for (minting {slug}@{backend_sha[:12]}:v{version} deterministically; a build-less record names the segment 'unknown' with the shape intact), upgrade_record stamps packet_id + packet_version on walked records, load_lens_record derives the ID on load for pre-field records and never rewrites a stamped one, and pack.py's lens packet + INDEX cite the record by packet_id. Limits, stated: the packet_id binds the walker branch's own machinery at the landing build (packet_id walker@3cbb08c375:v1); if the registry prefers the lens-packet form for the walked build, that binding happens at activation.
